text:
maya: Hi folks, first week here. Trying to get observability lined up for the private inference service. Problems: 1) Datadog dashboards show but I can't create monitors (403), 2) Grafana panels don't show the alerting UI (button disabled), 3) Sentry DSN for private cluster not in our secrets. Who handles each?

infra-bot: Welcome @maya! Typical steps: join `eng-observability`, request Grafana folder editor role, open infra ticket for Sentry project provisioning. Use template `obs-access-req`. Docs: https://redwood.internal/obs/onboard :wave:

ben: Hey @maya — for Datadog the 403 usually means you only have `dashboards_read` but not `monitors_write` or `api_key`/`app_key` pairing. If you need a quick test monitor I can create one under my app key and tag it `team:private-inference`. Example POST: 
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/monitor" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "DD-API-KEY: $DD_API_KEY" 
  -H "DD-APPLICATION-KEY: $DD_APP_KEY" 
  -d '{"name":"test: private inference latency","type":"metric alert","query":"avg(last_1m):avg:private.inference.latency{env:prod} > 1000","message":"@pagerduty test monitor","tags":["team:private-inference"]}'
```
I can create this and verify it routes to #private-inference-alerts.

charlie: Grafana issue: if alert button is greyed out hover text?? If it says "feature disabled" it means our self-hosted Grafana has per-organization alerting off for private clusters. If it says "no permission" we need to add you as Editor on the folder. Send me the dashboard UID (Dashboards -> Share -> Link -> uid=...).

maya: Dashboard UID is `pR9fK3xy`. The hover tooltip says "insufficient permissions".

charlie: OK that's permissions. I'll make you Editor + Alerting on the `private-inference` folder. That should enable the Alerts tab. If you still see issues, logout/login or clear cookies.

maya: Thanks! For Sentry I opened ticket INFOBS-432 with slug `private-inference-maya` and linked the service repo. Do we get public and server DSNs?

ben: Infra typically provides a server DSN and optionally a public DSN depending on the deployment policy. In INFOBS-432 include: repo, desired slug, envs, and whether frontend public DSN is required. Infra will update the secret store and the private deploy mapping.

infra-bot: INFOBS-432 acknowledged. ETA 48 hours. To expedite add `urgent` label. Use this template: https://redwood.internal/infra/new?template=obs-access-req

maya: Also trying to put a Grafana panel into Confluence runbook. Any tips for auth?

confluence-bot: We support two options: 1) signed short-lived iframe embeds from Grafana (recommended for private dashboards) 2) a static snapshot image if you don't want live auth. For signed embeds send the panel link and Confluence page ID; we will issue a token that lasts 1h.

charlie: When embedding, prefer a panel-level share link with `kiosk` layout. If you need it in an external customer-facing doc ask for an export snapshot instead of a live embed.

ben: I created the test Datadog monitor and tagged `team:private-inference`. It fired a test and routed to #private-inference-alerts. Maya, confirm you received the alert ping.

maya: Got it — saw the ping. Thanks everyone! Appreciate the quick help. I'll check the Grafana alerts once you add the Editor role and will update INFOBS-432 with whether we need a public DSN. :heart:
